title: Optimal partition and segregation problems driven by torsional rigidity
summary: Spectral optimal partition and segregation problems are deeply connected with harmonic maps, eigenfunctions, and the fine structure of nodal sets for linear elliptic equations. In this paper, we show that replacing the spectral energy by torsional rigidity leads to a genuinely different theory. The resulting optimal configurations are governed locally not by harmonic equations, but by torsion-type energies and unstable free boundary problems, thereby creating a natural bridge between optimal partition theory and the analysis of sublinear free boundary phenomena.
